subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rectifie"** is incorrectly spelt and should be** "Rectify". **(सुधारना)

 
 
• **Example:** The technician was called to rectify the electrical fault in the system.
 
 
 
• **"Rectify"** means to correct or fix something. (सुधारना)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager promised to **rectify **the issues raised by the employees.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Resist** (प्रतिरोध करना): To withstand the action or effect of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She tried to **resist** the temptation to eat the chocolate cake.
 
 
 
• **Recruit** (भर्ती करना): To enlist someone in the armed forces or to hire someone for a job.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to **recruit** 50 new employees this year.
 
 
 
• **Repulse** (वापस धकेलना): To drive back by force.
 
 
• **Example:** The army managed to** repulse** the invading forces.
 
 

1f8:Td9d,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
